svg.text: hole: grown-up pokes with a pencil/awl
Calibration: the black bar must measure
exactly 100 mm and the square 20x20 mm.
Use card ~1 mm (cereal box) for parts.
github.com/dev-repos/kids-robotics-projects · Kids.JoinDev · CC BY 4.0 · Grown-ups do all craft-knife cutting.
3 mm cardboard. Hip plates glue on the two shaft faces of the TT motor (gearbox end DOWN).
Ø30 round the shaft; blue = motor (66 long)
Ø30 round the shaft; blue = motor (66 long)
Hip peg exactly 30 mm straight above the shaft - this sets the swing.
Glue A+A and B+B = two 6 mm cranks. D-hole Ø5.4, 3.7 across the flat: snug on the shaft + hot glue.
A has the flat on the lobe side, B away from it: same shaft = pins OPPOSITE = 180° apart.
Lay it on the drawing: body, both
white shafts and the rear nub
Different? Move the hip peg so it
is still 30 mm above the shaft.
